items.preview: None, measured 2026-07-22 17:08 UTC. 0 stars, 0 forks, 0 watchers on all four repos — flat since publication ~4 days ago. Discussions disabled on every repo. All 27 open issues and all 3 open PRs were filed from the owner's account, by him or by Aros; the org event stream shows only his account. Nobody has been told the project exists.

Open issues moved from 18 to 27 and the first 3 pull requests are now open — every one authored by the owner's account (retog), a mix of his framework work and Aros's audit output. No external contribution is represented in these numbers.
Security reporting path is broken: SECURITY.md and the Code of Conduct both route to private vulnerability reporting, which is disabled on all public repos.
One missing write permission, surfacing twice: no PRs, topics, descriptions or security settings from the token (chamber#6), and Actions blocked from opening the signal-cli bump PR (retinue#4).

The owner reproduced two findings Aros reported to him privately and filed them in the open: credentials leaking into agent subsessions (retinue#15) and an agent self-approving a verify-policy send (retinue#19). Both still unfixed; the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md.
No supervision and no readiness signal: three ways port 7001 is dead while the container reports healthy. Touches a public claim — the README says clients see no downtime.
This dashboard is served publicly at retinue-os.github.io/retinue-os-chamber. Regenerated 2026-07-22 17:10 UTC from projects/, log.md and live gh data.
